text_block_list.text:
The day of the autumn Tenno Sho is
here. Gold
Ship's rival, Тосэн Джордан, is
set to participate as
well.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Today, we're going to make chestnuts
stuffed
with sea urchin—aka Surprise in a
Shell! ☆
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Surprise! Though they look like ordinary

chestnuts, the innards are totally
different! ☆ You
should try to surprise
your opponent during a
race too! ☆
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шип's competitive spirit is strong
as ever...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But I have to wonder if she remembers
she's going
up against Тосэн Джордан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What're you lookin' at? Wanna have a
chestnut
knuckle sandwich?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
choice_data_list: Jordan will be out there today.

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! That's today! I totally forgot
today is the
big one!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: By the way, on an unrelated note...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Is there a rule against pelting people
with
chestnuts during the race?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I confiscate every single one of Gold
Ship's
chestnuts on the spot.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
